messages.subject: comparing angles of "segments" in trajectory
parts:
Hi all,

I am working with time series within two populations, and I am interested in whether the direction of shape change between sampling years changes. I know that I can measure the angles of vectors describing change across all sampling years using trajectory.analysis, but I am more interested in the angle of change between time points (i.e., does the direction of change in population A differ between time1->time2 and time2->time3?). I would also like to compare pop. A time1->time2 to pop. B time1->time2 or pop. B time2-time3, but this is less important for me than comparisons of changes between times within the same population.

I think I found a similar conversation from a while back about comparisons of vector lengths (rather than angles) between "segments" in a trajectory here, but I can't figure out how this would be done now that advanced.procD.lm is deprecated.

thanks
Grant

Grant,

 

All of the functionality of advanced.procD.lm (and more) is found in the function ‘pairwise’.  The vignette ‘Addition by Subtraction’ that accompanies current versions of geomorph has examples of its use, and the google comment you found from Mike for the previous user has discussion and code that can be adapted for your purposes.


Dean
